programme.desc: Josh quiere recuperar a su ex, pero sus engaños resurgen; Deja confronta a su novio por su propuesta indecente a dos strippers gemelas; Misti se entera de que su novio la está engañando nuevamente.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Je''nier tiene un secreto difícil de contar a Preston. Después, ¡son Nikki y Nikky las que persiguen al mismo hombre! ¿Ganará Nikki o Nikky el corazón de Kevin? ¿Kevin merece el amor de alguna de las dos mujeres?

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Kiki quiere casarse con el hombre que la engañó con su prima; Tayshun culpa a su novia por su infidelidad; una estrella porno quiere que el chico que le gusta represente una escena con ella.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Tanisha enfrenta a su novio y la bailarina; Brandi recurre a extremos para casarse; Ashley enseña a su colega la etiqueta stripper.

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, las muertes por accidentes viales por exceso de velocidad y embriaguez, siguen creciendo. A pesar de las tragedias, muchos conductores iresponsables quedan impunes, las leyes no logran frenar la creciente cifra de víctimas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Aguachica, un joven prometió grandes ganancias con criptomonedas, pero desapareció con el dinero de los inversionistas. En Bogotá, Daniel Gómez ofreció rentabilidades del 8% con su empresa Taurex, pero tampoco cumplió. La criptomoneda Daily Cop también dejó a miles sin su dinero. Las estafas suman millones de dólares.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Fernanda, Marleny y Jonathan son víctimas de préstamos digitales que se convierten en cobros intimidantes. Séptimo Día investiga Call Centers que usan tácticas de intimidación para cobrar deudas. Las autoridades y expertos advierten sobre los riesgos de estas aplicaciones.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Los padres luchan por mantener a sus hijos adolescentes y preadolescentes a salvo de los peligros de Internet.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Itagüí Antioquia, dos hermanos adolecentes son asesinados en su propia casa por su tío, quién al parecer sufría ataques de esquizofrenia. Cuatro meses después del homicidio, el asesino es capturado y recluido en la cárcel de máxima seguridad en Itagúi, pagando una condena de 54 años de prisión, mientras que los padres de los menores rehacen su vida por caminos separados.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2011, en Anzoátegui, Tolima, los gemelos Diego y Juan Sebastián, de 7 años, fueron secuestrados por Pedro Andrés Laserna, expareja de su madre Mariela, tras ella terminar la relación y denunciarlo por violencia. Laserna exigió dinero y su regreso a cambio de los niños, pero finalmente los asesinó. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por secuestro extorsivo agravado y homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Janeth soñaba con una vida mejor, pero fue asesinada por su esposo celoso en medio de promesas de refugio en Canadá. Sus hijos quedaron bajo la custodia de Carlos, mientras sus cenizas volvían a su ciudad natal.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En La Montañita, Caquetá, Jhon Jairo Marín rehace su vida con Yineth Mosquera, quien, celosa del hijo de su pareja, Esneider, termina atentando contra la vida del menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Edenis Barrera Benavides, líder social y voluntaria de la Defensa Civil, fue brutalmente asesinada en 2014.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Guarne, Antioquia, Jaime Iván Martínez fue capturado por el homicidio de su esposa María Gladis Arango, su amiga Natalia García, y sus dos hijos de 5 y 8 años, ahorcados en 2015. programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Alexa está demandando a su novio de un año y medio por cancelar abruptamente el viaje de su vida porque necesitaba traer a su hijo de 7 años.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Gabriella está demandando a su ex empleadora, Jaqueline Mendoza, por $600,000 por angustia mental y despido injustificado luego de sufrir un ataque de pánico durante una celebración de la empresa.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: En 1987, Jhonatan Jiménez, de 3 años, fue secuestrado en Bogotá por un conocido de la familia. Treinta y dos años después, su hermano Juan lo encontró en Noruega mediante una prueba de ADN. Ahora llamado Jhon Erick, se reencontraron y él regresó a Colombia, donde su familia le organizó una emotiva bienvenida. Juan, actor y documentalista, ahora narra esta historia de dolor, injusticia y reencuentro familiar.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Porfirio Ramírez, 'El Aeropirata', secuestró un avión en 2005, motivado por desesperación y deseos de hablar con el presidente Uribe. Tras años en prisión y actuación en cine, lucha con su destino.

programme.title: Enviado Especial
programme.desc: Jalis de la Serna viaja al lugar donde revolucionan nuestras vidas: Silicon Valley. Allí intenta encontrar la respuesta a una pregunta: Qué uso hacen de nuestros datos las compañías tecnológicas

programme.title: Policías en Acción
programme.desc: Un hotel, al ver cómo un cliente les causa varios destrozos, llama a la policía. Los agentes intentan mediar lo que ocurre. El acusado es un ciudadano japonés.

programme.title: Winchester Life

Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life

There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. - We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Deep in the backroads of the Midwest there are stories locals rarely tell out loud. Stories of pale figures with oversized heads watching from the trees. Stories passed down in whispers and warnings. The Melon Heads legend has haunted Michigan, Ohio, and surrounding states for decades. Some say they are the result of dark experiments. Others believe they are something far older. Something that never left the woods.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors

programme.title: The Journey Within

programme.title: The Journey Within

programme.title: The Journey Within

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: It's the second day of the Alabama Turkey season, and we hit the woods with Dr. Mike Chamberlain and Aaron Warbritton from The Hunting Public in search of a longbeard. programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This one is special. We took Ron aka “Don”, a WoodHaven employee who helps assemble our pot calls, out to Tennessee for a turkey hunt he’ll never forget. After 35 years of not harvesting a Turkey, Don finally gets his shot.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Some mornings just remind you why we do this. We found ourselves in Southwest Alabama on one of the prettiest mornings a turkey hunter could ever ask for — cool air, soft light breaking through the timber, and gobbles echoing through the hardwoods. Even better, we got to share it with a great friend, and that’s what makes hunts like this truly special. This is what turkey hunting is all about — good friends, beautiful mornings, and chasing longbeards in God’s country.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.desc: Jamie kicks things off by cooking up his Crazy Good Pork Burger—a naughty little treat that takes fast food to the next level. Then it’s sticky mango prawns, a speedy sharing platter with a shortcut to phenomenal flavor.

programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.desc: The art of cooking once and eating twice. Today Silvia makes some divine ricotta filled Italian crepes, and then using the leftover ingredients shows us how to create a rustic story pie from the North of Italy and a heart baked - pasta, Pasta Al Forno.

programme.title: Evolving Vegan
programme.desc: In the Capital of Weird, a diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, - fried “chik’n” sandwiches, and Vietnamese “catfish”.

programme.title: Zumbo's Just Desserts
programme.desc: It’s time to go big or go home. Our dessert makers are challenged to push themselves to new heights and build a dessert structure that reaches a minimum height of half a metre.

programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food
programme.desc: Jamie’s cooking up his high-speed Ginger Shakin’ Beef, teamed with one-minute-wonder veg, pak choi. Followed by crispy squid and smashed avo, an irresistible, impressive plate of food that’s a joy to make and a pleasure to share.

programme.desc: Diana goes Japanese: starting with her recipe for ‘Okonomiyaki’, created using ingredients found in your fridge and pantry. programme.title: Asia Unplated

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Desire Mapping guides you to live from the heart, focusing on how you want to feel rather than just what you want to do. Through practices like Soul Limber, appreciation, attention management, Core Desired Feelings, and exploring your inner selves, you gain clarity, agency, joy, and purpose in creating a fulfilling life.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Set down your Core Desired Feelings and explore the words that shape your inner world. This practice reveals patterns, clarifies your choices, and turns intention into living energy. Your feelings and words become a beacon, guiding you to live from the heart with focus and purpose.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Step into Intentional Creation using your Core Desired Feelings as your guide. Align actions with heart-centered intentions, release what no longer serves you, and transform your goals into sacred desires. Cultivate agency, joy, and flow as your inner world shapes your outer reality.

programme.title: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Integrate your Core Desired Feelings through daily practice, reflection, and heart-centered rituals. Using mindfulness, breath, and prayer, cultivate sacred connection, peace, and purpose. Return to your heart each day, and let your love and clarity ripple into the world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.desc: If you take care of the bookends of the day, the rest of the day will take care of itself. It’s such a powerful idea for people to understand that when we wake up in the morning, most people wake up with anxiety, fear, and negativity. So, we need to do something right away to set ourselves straight, to create the conditions for the best day possible, regardless of the circumstances that we're facing in the outside world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.desc: Addiction is felt and experienced in the mind. The mind is a terrible master but a wonderful servant. We must understand its functions as it’s an important aspect of addiction recovery and learning how to thrive. So, the key question is this: How do you get the mind to serve the heart, rather than staying trapped in serving the mind? Only heightened awareness can end the inner war.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Definitive statements are comforting. They give life structure and clear direction. But what happens when your declarations are at odds with your subconscious desires?

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson

How we see ourselves and our relationship to God influences our view of our relationships with other people. Today we're going to examine that view from a place of love.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: A miracle happens when you stop thinking with fear and start thinking with love. Your greatest power lies in your mind. To establish stronger connections, you need to go into every situation requesting to be an instrument of love. When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: In the following lesson, we'll discover how the ego mind influences both our way of thinking and our relationships. programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson

programme.desc: Lisa Garr talks with Fast Company Senior writer Nicole LaPorte. She researched the divide between the haves & have-nots including examining the vicious competitiveness of college admissions, bribes & lack of ethics within certain departments.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Lisa Garr talks with best-selling author and spiritual teacher Anita Moorjani, who discusses life as an empath. Her latest book is “Sensitive is the New Strong,” which talks about the importance of having boundaries, especially as an empathic person.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: Founder, Glenn Marsden, of Imperfectly Perfect Campaign, and Jeremy Jackson, former Baywatch star share their personal journeys with body dysmorphia and how it led to a worldwide campaign. A young man faces his fears and a tale of kindness at 30,000 ft.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: Laura Di Franco, CEO of Brave Healer Productions, discusses brave healing and the power of sharing our stories. And, meet Oyen the ginger cat and adorable kids from India, along with Daaji redefining meditation for a joyful heart.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: Join The Kitchen Psychic, Hannah McKitrick, as we talk ditching diets, embracing food freedom, and finding lightness in mind and body, alongside Susan Noles from The Golden Bachelor for some fun, and meditation leader Daaji discussing compassion.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: Raelene S. Weaver, author and TEDx speaker who's breaking barriers by normalizing boys' emotions. Witness a touching moment as a man in Italy feels a human touch after 30 years, and Daaji joins for another inspiring segment on our Soul Hugs series.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.desc: The body has inherent systems to slow and even reverse aging. When you activate these systems you increase stem cell production, reduce inflammation, increase antioxidant enzymes, build muscle, lose fat, and increase cognitive capacity.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.desc: Now that we understand the root causes of aging, how do we actually address the hallmarks of aging? What are the levers we have to optimize our health and longevity? Because medicine has it all wrong. We don't need to treat disease. When we focus on fostering optimal health, disease goes away as a side effect.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.desc: There are basic fundamental ways we can optimize our health, starting with topics we’ve already discussed, like eating well and exercising appropriately. But, just as important for health and longevity is the need to rest, relax, and connect with each other. Community is essential, and being of service to one another can help you heal.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.desc: Too much stress will take you down, but the right amount of stress at the right time can activate your body's repair and healing mechanisms. What natural elements stress our system in such a way that it then activates the body to heal?

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Your survival mind is wired to protect you from pain, but after loss it can spiral into worry and worst-case thinking. Learn the science of grief, how repetitive thoughts form deep mental pathways, and how to rewire your mind to heal and grow.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 1 introduces the practice of centering through the breath. When the mind drifts to regret or worry, we gently return—again and again. This meditation teaches concentration, presence, and compassion, reminding us that healing isn’t in never wandering, but in beginning again.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 2 invites us to examine the stories we tell about our worth, limits, and lives. By recognizing conditioned habits and outdated coping tools, we reconnect with our power of choice. This lesson reminds us that change is always possible—and that we can meet life with renewed care and curiosity.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 3 focuses on meeting anger and fear with compassion rather than resistance. By paying gentle attention to difficult emotions, we learn they are not bad—only painful when they define us. Using the breath as an anchor, we develop a kinder, wiser relationship to our inner experience.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 4 explores opening to joy by intentionally taking in the good. We examine habits of threat, perfectionism, and resistance, and practice savoring what’s nourishing and life-giving. Through gentle curiosity, this lesson shows how joy can restore resilience and help us meet life with more ease.

programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Frank Turner: Live from Shamrock Rebellion
programme.desc: Recorded live at Flogging Molly’s Shamrock Rebellion festival in Las Vegas, singer-songwriter Frank Turner and his band The Sleeping Souls deliver a high-energy performance filled with punk spirit, sharp storytelling, and crowd-fueled anthems.

programme.title: Don't Go Gentle: A Film About IDLES
programme.desc: Don’t Go Gentle chronicles the rise of British punk band IDLES, exploring how a group of friends from Bristol transformed pain and vulnerability into creative power. Through candid interviews, raw live performances, and emotional moments, the film captures the band’s journey from small clubs to international acclaim.

programme.title: Jutes: Live From Los Angeles
programme.desc: Jutes celebrates his new album with a live show from Los Angeles’ El Rey Theatre, bringing fans into the room for an intimate performance.

programme.title: Say Anything: Is A Real Boy 20th Anniversary Tour Live from Los Angeles
programme.desc: Say Anything performs ...Is A Real Boy live at The Wiltern, celebrating the album’s 20th anniversary with a special concert event.

programme.title: All Things Must Pass
programme.desc: Colin Hanks explores Tower Records' history, from its rise and fall to the legacy of Russ Solomon.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with rapper-singer Lil Xan (Diego Leanos) for a candid conversation about therapy, vulnerability, and the hard work of getting healthy. Xan retraces his sobriety journey—from daily dependency and seizures after going cold turkey to celebrating three years sober—and reflects on losing peers from his SoundCloud generation, rejecting the “die young to be a legend” myth, and discovering that his art is stronger in recovery. They dig into fitness as therapy, inner work vs. outer success, and Xan’s 2024 album Diego, which he calls his best, made completely sober.

programme.title: There We Were, Now Here We Are... The Making of Oasis
programme.desc: This documentary commemorates the ten-year anniversary of Oasis' Definitely Maybe, learning the stories behind the songs and album recording.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Host Joel Madden talks with Jesse Leach, vocalist of Killswitch Engage, about the band’s legacy, mental health, and rediscovering balance after years on the road. Leach reflects on growing up in a religious home, finding community through punk and hardcore, and building a life grounded in creativity and purpose.

programme.title: Queen: From Rags to Rhapsody
programme.desc: This documentary tells the story of Queen’s journey from a struggling band to the moment they captured the UK’s hearts with what was to become the greatest song.

programme.title: A Night out with the Backstreet Boys
programme.desc: Backstreet Boys perform an intimate 1998 concert in Cologne for 200 fans, featuring early hits with a live string section and choir.

programme.title: Liam Gallagher: Live at Knebworth
programme.desc: Liam Gallagher of Oasis gives 160,000 fans hope through his music at Knebworth. Known as 'the King of Knebworth', he delivers joy.

programme.title: 311 Day 2024 Live from Las Vegas: Night 1
programme.desc: 311 performs a 2+ hour set of fan favorites and surprises live from Park MGM in Las Vegas, celebrating 311 Day with an unforgettable Night 1 experience.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Travie McCoy discusses his gradual rise in music, from humble beginnings to headlining. He shares a metaphor from his album cover and tells a story about breaking his neck riding a dirt bike.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Actor, comedian, and master impressionist Jay Pharoah joins Joel Madden for a candid talk about early jobs, lessons from Charlie Murphy, and finding joy in comedy. Pharoah shares stories from his time on the road, his new special Jared, and how humor became his way to connect and uplift others.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Catherine Cohen: Come For Me
programme.desc: In this acclaimed one-woman show, comedian and cabaret star Catherine Cohen delivers a sharp, musical, and self-aware exploration of modern womanhood. Blending stand-up, original songs, and theatrical flair, Cohen takes the audience through her thoughts on dating, therapy, faith, and self-image — all with biting wit, charm, and glitter. Filmed live in New York City, Come For Me celebrates confidence, vulnerability, and the chaos of being thirty and thriving.

programme.title: Jonathan Van Ness Stand-Up Special: Fun & Slutty
programme.desc: Jonathan Van Ness performs his debut stand-up special in his hometown, Austin, TX, blending comedy, sex-ed themes, and audience interaction.

programme.title: In Conversation Lucy Dacus and Katie Gavin
programme.desc: Dacus and Gavin chat in LA, discussing Dacus's new record and their friendship, filled with giggles.

programme.title: The Voidz: Tomorrow A Special
programme.desc: The Voidz perform live in a special TOMORROW! episode, offering an immersive look into their experimental sound and creative world.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Australian singer, songwriter, and drummer G Flip joins Joel Madden to talk about their rise from session musician to chart-topping solo artist. They discuss growing up in Melbourne, the success of their #1 ARIA album, life in Los Angeles, and lessons learned from years of touring. The conversation also dives into creativity, manifestation, and how G Flip found confidence in their artistry, identity, and marriage.

programme.title: ODESZA: The Last Goodbye Finale Live from The Gorge
programme.desc: Filmed during the sold-out final night of ODESZA’s The Last Goodbye Tour at the legendary Gorge Amphitheatre in Washington, this breathtaking performance blends cinematic visuals, live percussion, and emotional electronic soundscapes. The finale includes two encore songs from the July 5 performance, creating an unforgettable experience from one of electronic music’s most visionary acts.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel talks to British singer-songwriter Maisie Peters about her album Forescence and being a non-identical twin.

programme.title: Future Islands: Live From Cat's Cradle
programme.desc: Future Islands stream live from Cat’s Cradle, celebrating 20 years from a room filled with memories.

programme.title: 10 Years of Noise and Confusion: Oasis Live at Barrowlands
programme.desc: Filmed live at Glasgow’s Barrowlands, Oasis performs Supersonic, Roll With It, and more in a “back to the roots” anniversary show capturing their raw live energy.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Salad Days: A Decade Of Punk In Washington, DC (1980-1990)
programme.desc: Acclaimed documentary on punk rock's rise in DC. Bands like Bad Brains booked their own shows. Predated the 90s alternative explosion.

programme.title: Lost Evenings VI: Night 1 – Acoustic Duo with Matt Nasir
programme.desc: The opening night of Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim features an intimate acoustic set from Frank Turner and Matt Nasir. The performance blends heartfelt storytelling with stripped-down versions of fan favorites, including “Be More Kind,” “The Way I Tend to Be,” and a moving duet with KT Tunstall. Turner connects deeply with the audience while revisiting early songs and debuting new arrangements in this special evening of community, humor, and reflection.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Drummer and producer Cody Hanson of Hinder joins Joel Madden to reflect on two decades of the band’s journey—from college shows in Oklahoma to multi-platinum success with “Lips of an Angel.” They discuss songwriting, evolving as musicians, and the making of their new single “Bring Me Back to Life.”

programme.title: Lamb of God: Killadelphia
programme.desc: Lamb of God's Killadelphia showcases the thrash-metal band at The Trocadero in 2005, featuring a recorded set, candid footage, and an all-access portrait.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week’s episode of Artist Friendly, we’re bringing back Joel Madden’s conversation with Ziggy Marley. Joel and Ziggy go deep on the making of his album Brightside, the song he wrote as a love letter to his father Bob, and what it means to find your purpose without trying to be someone else. One of the most grounded, soulful conversations to date.

programme.title: The Chicks: Top of the World Tour Live
programme.desc: The Chicks, Grammy Award winners, launched their 2003 tour with Top Of The World Tour Live. Enjoy hits like 'Goodbye Earl,' 'A Home,' 'Landslide,' and more.

programme.title: Bowling For Soup: Live and Very Attractive
programme.desc: Bowling for Soup performs live on a U.K. tour, delivering hits like 1985 and Girl All The Bad Guys Want with high-energy pop-punk style.

programme.title: Porno for Pyros: Horns, Thorns En Halos Farewell Tour Live from Los Angeles
programme.desc: Porno for Pyros take the stage one final time for their Horns, Thorns En Halos Farewell Tour, performing live from The Belasco Theater in Los Angeles. Frontman Perry Farrell, guitarist Peter DiStefano, drummer Stephen Perkins, and bassist Martyn LeNoble deliver an electrifying and emotional performance that spans their entire career — from hits like Pets and Tahitian Moon to deep cuts and spoken interludes that showcase their surreal, art-rock energy. Captured exclusively on Veeps, this farewell show celebrates three decades of psychedelic alternative rock and the enduring chemistry that defined the band’s sound.

programme.title: Tomorrow: Scarlet Rae
programme.desc: Scarlet Rae headlines Episode 3 of TOMORROW!, featuring artists and creatives in a visually driven showcase directed by Rebekah Sherman-Myntti.

programme.title: Metal From the Dirt: Rez Metal on the Navajo Nation
programme.desc: Navajo (Diné) musicians and scene builders trace the rise of Rez Metal, from generator-powered desert shows to Hogan rehearsals, blending heavy music with culture, pride, and survival.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week’s episode of Artist Friendly, we’re bringing back Joel Madden’s conversation with Ziggy Marley. Joel and Ziggy go deep on the making of his album Brightside, the song he wrote as a love letter to his father Bob, and what it means to find your purpose without trying to be someone else. One of the most grounded, soulful conversations to date.

programme.title: Maestro
programme.desc: Maestro follows Grammy award-winning conductor Paavo Järvi and brilliant musicians performing in sold-out halls worldwide.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Andrew McMahon discusses his journey in music, from being a child to an artist, and his experience with Drive Through Records.

programme.title: Judas Priest: Epitaph
programme.desc: Judas Priest performs a powerful final tour set at Hammersmith Apollo, featuring songs spanning their 40-year career.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden interviews Chet Hanks on rebuilding his life with gratitude, navigating the spotlight, and balancing acting with music.

programme.title: Mae Martin: "I'm a TV"
programme.desc: Mae Martin’s I’m a TV, captured live in Los Angeles. Blending intimate indie-pop songs with witty onstage banter, Mae performs new material on the eve of the album’s release and sharing stories that inspired tracks like “Say the Word,” “Try Me,” “Don’t Get Tired of Me,” and “Garbage Strike.” A confessional, funny, and heartfelt set about love, reinvention, and finding calm in the chaos.

programme.title: Flogging Molly: Live from Las Vegas
programme.desc: Flogging Molly performs a St. Patrick’s Day celebration live from Las Vegas with a high-energy set.

programme.title: Urzila Carlson: It’s Personal
programme.desc: Urzila Carlson performs her stand-up special filmed in Brisbane, delivering sharp humor and personal stories from her global tour.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Daryl Palumbo of Glassjaw and Head Automatica. Daryl reflects on three decades of genre-defying music, the freedom he’s always pursued as an artist, the self-doubt and restlessness that shaped his work, and how fatherhood became the most grounding and fulfilling experience of his life.

programme.title: Cypress Hill: Insane in the Brain
programme.desc: Cypress Hill tells the story of their unique sound rooted in authenticity. Director Estevan Oriol uses archival footage to explore the band's lasting legacy.

programme.title: Incubus: The Morning View Sessions
programme.desc: The Morning View Sessions captures Incubus' fourth album release day. Features live hits Nice to Know You, Wish You Were Here, Warning, and Circles.

programme.title: Flogging Molly: Shamrock Rebellion Live from Las Vegas
programme.desc: Flogging Molly headline Shamrock Rebellion, a Saint Patrick’s Day celebration live from Las Vegas, Nevada. Featuring a high-energy set of Celtic punk anthems and performances from Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls, the concert captures the spirit of punk unity, rebellion, and Irish pride.

programme.title: Give It Up: The Greatest Concert of Comedy Songs
programme.desc: Filmed live in Los Angeles, Avery Pearson hosts a one-night-only comedy concert blending music, satire, and stand-up. Featuring Jay Pharoah, Arden Myrin, Adam Ray, Beth Stelling, Luke Null, JR De Guzman, Jeremiah Watkins, Josh Adam Meyers, and more, the show delivers original comedy songs and musical parodies about life, fame, and delusion.

programme.title: James Taylor: Live at the Beacon Theatre
programme.desc: James Taylor performs live at the Beacon Theatre, delivering songs from Hourglass alongside classics in a special concert featuring unseen footage.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Benji & Joel Madden / Cameron Diaz & Katherine Power: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Good Charlotte’s Benji and Joel Madden share their journey into artist management, while Cameron Diaz and Katherine Power discuss building their organic wine brand, Avaline.

programme.title: An Evening With Becky Lucas
programme.desc: Becky Lucas delivers a candid stand-up set with sharp, self-deprecating humor, sharing personal stories and punchlines from her early material with wit and honesty.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Magnolia Park frontman Joshua Roberts joins Joel Madden for a heartfelt conversation about anime, identity, and carving out space in rock music. Joshua reflects on navigating racism in the scene, channeling emotion into art, and leading Magnolia Park’s creative community with resilience and purpose. From social media strategy to self-belief, this episode dives deep into what it means to stay authentic while inspiring others to do the same.

programme.title: Stone Roses - Made Of Stone
programme.desc: In 2012, a resurrection no one thought possible took place when legendary band, The Stone Roses reformed after 16 years. With unprecedented access to previously unseen archive footage, MADE OF STONE is a revealing journey through the life of one of the most revered and influential bands in British music history.

programme.title: Stone Roses - Made Of Stone
programme.desc: In 2012, a resurrection no one thought possible took place when legendary band, The Stone Roses reformed after 16 years. With unprecedented access to previously unseen archive footage, MADE OF STONE is a revealing journey through the life of one of the most revered and influential bands in British music history.

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.desc: A long lost live concert performance from The Heartbreakers explosive 1984 reunion world tour that included fellow Dolls Sylvain Sylvain & Jerry Nolan plus Billy Rath! programme.title: Kurt Cobain - All Apologies
programme.desc: All Apologies is a highly emotional tribute and inquisitive journey into both the man, his true persona, and his music. Daringly, it charts the downward spiral and isolation that brought down Kurt Cobain. Featuring musical selections from Cobain's list of top favorites as well as rare footage and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: String Theory: Guitar Obsessed
programme.desc: String Theory: Guitar Obsessed delivers a humorous but reverent look at why we love the guitar. Among the 24 distinguished people in the film: Execs from 5 major manufactures, 4 well known internet instructors and retail guitar store owners in the USA and the UK...plus distinguished professors and even the former Deputy Director of the FBI. If you play guitar, you will want to see this movie.

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Get Thrashed Around The World
programme.desc: Stellar metal bands came out of Germany, UK, France, Brazil, Canada, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Canada, and more as part of the Thrash Metal movement. Members of bands like Slayer, Metallica, Slipknot, and Exodus reminisce about their favorite bands and the best musicians of the era. A virtual encyclopedia of metal bands that toured the world, but that fans may have forgotten or can now discover.

programme.title: Stiv: No Compromise No Regrets
programme.desc: Almost 30 years after Stiv's mysterious death in Paris, the Dead Boys have become the stuff of (Punk) legends but unsurprisingly, the story remains largely untold. How did this native from Girard, Ohio end up living the life of Riley in Paris, France' Was Stiv really hit by a car (or a taxi...) on that fateful day' Who was the real Stiv Bators' These are a few of the questions answered in STIV.

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Finnish Metal Special
programme.desc: From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

programme.title: Folk Metal Forest Feast
programme.desc: Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Thrash Metal Attack
programme.desc: Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

programme.title: The Home of Heavy
programme.desc: Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: Together We Rise
programme.desc: A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts Part 2
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with a concert program; under the baton of Christian Schumann, the bands team up and perform from "Lord of the Rings," "The Witcher," "League of Legends" and more.

programme.title: Beethoven -- Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra and Chorus in a recorded performance of Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 at Barbican Hall in London.

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: Things change for a middle-class couple (Alan Alda, Carol Burnett) and two other couples they vacation with four times a year.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: All your favorite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the concert hall, together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mikhail Pletnev Conducts Rimski-Korsakov
programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music.

programme.title: Schubert -- Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of "Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944" by Franz Schubert.

programme.title: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005).

programme.title: Symphonies Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhausorchester; recorded in Leipzig's Gewandhaus.

programme.title: Mahler: Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra.

programme.title: Works for Lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017.

programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
La Bayadere
programme.desc: The Paris Opera Ballet performs the work choreographed by Rudolf Nureyev.

programme.title: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37; pianist Maya Oganyan makes her solo debut with the orchestra.

programme.title: Gershwin's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.

programme.title: Chopin: Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with a concert program; under the baton of Christian Schumann, the bands team up and perform from "Lord of the Rings," "The Witcher," "League of Legends" and more.

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Schubert -- Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of "Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944" by Franz Schubert.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.

programme.title: Works by Mendelssohn & Hensel
programme.desc: A 2020 performance of Mendelssohn and Hensel at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Germany.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 & Elgar's Enigma Variations
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival.

programme.title: Beethoven: Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No 3 in E-flat major, Op 55, Eroica.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Nikolay Lugansky presents works by Rachmaninoff as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov.

programme.title: Faure's Requiem
programme.desc: Winchester Cathedral Orchestra and the English Chamber Choir perform the piece; host John Gielgud.

programme.title: Descent Into the Maelstrom
programme.desc: In the 1980s, Philip Glass creates music for the Australian Dance Theatre based on "Descent into the Maelstrom" by Edgar Allan Poe.

programme.title: Berlioz
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz's "Symphonie," Op. 14; this performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Mozart Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt performs with Casco Phil, under the baton of Benjamin Haemhouts.

programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies - to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune and many more.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programme.desc: Nino Rota aims to give everyone a moment of happiness; his "Third Symphony" sparkles with Italian sunlight.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna from Vienna's Café Sperl; the ensemble consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic.

programme.title: Bach: Goldberg Variations BWV 988
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's "Goldberg Variations BWV 988" at the Leipzig Bach Festival.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Descent Into the Maelstrom
programme.desc: In the 1980s, Philip Glass creates music for the Australian Dance Theatre based on "Descent into the Maelstrom" by Edgar Allan Poe.

programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies - to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune and many more.

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programme.desc: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programme.title: Mahler, The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Leonard Bernstein was the first conductor to record all of Mahler's symphonies on disk and on video.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, 'Emperor'
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73 ('Emperor'), featuring Beatrice Rana as the soloist. Recorded at Barbican Hall in London, UK, in 2022.

programme.title: The Morricone Duel
programme.desc: A live concert production offers a mixture of the Wild West with the soulful sound of Italy.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for Best Classical Solo Vocal Album "Crazy Girl Crazy" (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) in 2018 and took home the Grammy for Artist of the Year in 2022.

Unas muertes relacionadas entre sí y que esconden múltiples incógnitas.

programme.title: Memoria Negra
